sentences.text: Shri Aditya Garg, learned Public Prosecutor for the respondent No.2/State.
Heard on I.A.No.5559/2018, filed on behalf of the petitioner for dispensing with the filing certified copy of the judgment of the trial court.

Petitioner has filed criminal revision under Section 397 r/w 401 of the Cr.P.C. against the judgment dated 26.06.2018 passed by Sessions Judge, Neemuch in criminal appeal No.33/2018 whereby petitioner's conviction and sentence under Section 16 (1) (A) (1) Prevention Food Adulteration Act has been confirmed.
Petitioner has filed certified copy of the above mentioned lower appellate court and photocopy of the trial court judgment dated 06.02.2018.
Considering the aforesaid, the I.A.No.5559/2018 is allowed.
Record of the both the lower courts be called for.
No notice is required to be sent to respondent/State as Shri Aditya Garg, learned counsel has already appeared on behalf of the respondent No.2/State.

Appearing counsel for the parties heard on I.A.No.5483/2018, first application under Section 397 (1) of the Cr.P.C., for suspension of custodial sentence of the petitioner convicted for offence under Section 16 (1) (A) (1) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentenced to 6 months simple imprisonment with a fine of Rs. 1000/- with default stipulation and the lower appellate court has affirmed the conviction and sentence as recorded by the trial court.

Appearing counsel for the petitioner contends that during HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH BENCH AT INDORE trial before the trial court, the petitioner was released on regular bail and his custodial sentence was previously suspended by the lower appellate Court and there is no possibility of early hearing of this criminal revision before this Court, hence, it is prayed that custodial sentence of petitioner be suspended during the pendency of this criminal revision, which is strongly opposed by the learned Public Prosecutor appearing on behalf of the respondent No.2/State.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH BENCH AT INDORE
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Considering the rival contentions of the parties, without commenting on the merits of the case, as there is no possibility of early hearing of this criminal revision before this Court, I.A.No.5483/2018 is allowed and it is ordered that on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 30,000/- (Rupees Hemant Jadhav vs Department Of Food And Drugs ... on 24 July, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/141145920/
1 Thirty Thousands only) by the petitioner with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court concerned for his regular appearance before the Registry of this Court firstly on 18.12.2018 and on such subsequent dates as may be fixed by the Registry for the same purpose in future, the petitioner jail sentence be suspended and he be released on bail.
List in the next week for admission.
